  LEGAL DESCRIPTION/APN: Americana at Brand
  APN # 5642-014-069, -072, -074, -078, -079, -
  185, -186, -187, -189, -190, -193, -194, -195, -196,
  -197, -198, -199, -200, -201 , -202, -951, -952

  CASE PLANNER:  Roger Kiesel, Senior Planner

  PROJECT DESCRIPTION
  Americana at Brand, LLC has requested the City enter into a Development
  Agreement to comply with GMC Section 30.26.100, including the provision of
  certain public benefits to the City, the Development Agreement term and the
  regulations of signage in accordance with GMC Chapter 30.26. for ASOZ Non-
  Accessory Signs and Sign Structures and Animated Signs and Sign Structures.

  DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT
  When approving an Advertising Signage Overlay Zone (ASOZ), or an
  amendment to an ASOZ that increases or permits new, additional, or different
  signage, GMC section 30.26.100 requires applicants seeking installation of such
  signs to enter into a statutory development agreement with the City in compliance
  with the law (Government Code §§65864 through 65869.5 (the "Development
  Agreement Statutes")). Americana at Brand, LLC, has requested the City enter
  into a Development Agreement to comply with GMC section 30.26.100, including
  the provision of certain public benefits to the City, the Development Agreement
  term, and the regulation of signage in accordance with GMC Chapter 30.26.

  ENVIRONMENTAL DETERMINATION
  In March 2010, the City Council adopted a Final Mitigated Negative Declaration
  (MND) analyzing the environmental impacts of Ordinance 5688 which added
  Chapter 30.26 to the GMC, and in August 2013, an Addendum to the MND was
  prepared for Ordinance 5804 which amended GMC Chapter 30.26 and Chapter 30.33.
  The proposed Development Agreement implements GMC Section 30.26.100 by
  permitting signage development allowed within the ASOZ as previously analyzed in the
  MND and Addendum; no further CEQA review is required .

  2
 Planning Commission Minutes
December 18, 2019

  STAFF
  Staff member Roger Kiesel, planner on the case, presented the staff report. He
  answered questions from the Planning Commissioners. He requested the
  Planning Commissioners that they consider approval to the City Council to enter
  into a statutory development agreement between the City of Glendale and
  Americana at Brand, LLC, relating to signage in the Advertising Signage Overlay
  Zone (ASOZ).

  Mr. Kiesel stated that the Community Development Department staff recommends
  that the Planning Commission recommend approval of the development agreement
  to the City Council.

  APPLICANT
  Mr. Ben Howell, EVP, General Counsel - CARUSO, consultant on the project, stated
  that he has read the staff report and will comply with all the conditions of the motion.

  WRITTEN COMMUNICATION
  IN FAVOR  None.
  IN OPPOSITION:  None.
  INTERESTED PARTY: None.

  SPEAKING AT THE HEARING
  IN FAVOR:  No one.
  INTERESTED PARTY: No one.
  IN OPPOSITION:  No one.

  DISCUSSION BY PLANNING COMMISSIONERS
  Planning Commissioners discussed the proposed project and made the following motion.

  MOTION
  Moved by Planning Commissioner Chraghchian, and seconded by Planning
  Commissioner Astorian, that upon consideration of the proposed Development
  Agreement (DA) relating to the implementation of an Advertising Signage Overlay
  Zone (ASOZ), that the Development Agreement (DA) is consistent with the
  Glendale General Plan, the Town Center Specific Plan, and the Downtown
  Specific Plan (DSP) in that the DA implements revenue sharing for signs that are
  already permitted under the Glendale Municipal Code, provided for by the ASOZ
  designation and identified by the August, 2013 Zone Map Amendment and is
  therefore consistent with the DSP; and the General Plan land use designation for
  the Town Center District is DSP and thus the DA is consistent with the Land Use
  Element of the General Plan, and the Planning Commission hereby recommends
  that the City Council approve the ASOZ DA.

  Adopted this 18th day of December, 2019.
